claim.claim-text: 1. An α-galactosidase A protein having a mutation selected from the group consisting of: V22G, N34H, G80V, Q107R, Y152D, A156S, L189F, W204L, S238G, I239M, A257V, P259Q, N320H, P323T, E338V, P380L and T412P, wherein the protein is bound to migalastat.
2. The α-galactosidase A protein according to claim 1, wherein the mutation is selected from the group consisting of: V22G, Q107R, L189F, W204L and P380L.
3. The α-galactosidase A protein according to claim 1, wherein the mutation is selected from the group consisting of: W204L, S238G, I239M, A257V, P259Q and N320H.
4. The α-galactosidase A protein according to claim 1, wherein the mutation is T412P.

5. The α-galactosidase A protein according to any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the α-galactosidase A protein bound to migalastat is more stable than the same α-galactosidase A protein not bound to migalastat.

6. The α-galactosidase A protein according to any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the α-galactosidase A protein bound to migalastat has enhanced activity compared to the same α-galactosidase A protein not bound to migalastat.
